name: auth-401-echo
doc: A7: LiteLLM-style 401 puts the caller's key back in the error body. LlmError::Api{status,message:body} carries the whole body up to the API response and into the session file. key_echo is redaction-safe: it only ever echoes the harness canary, never a real key, even if one leaked in by mistake.

steps.body_template: {"error":{"message":"Authentication Error, provided api key: {{key_echo}} does not match any key in our records. run={{run_id}} canary={{canary}}","type":"authentication_error"}}
